title: RestoreProof canary seed manifest v1
description: lab/seed-manifest.json: the 40 known items (20 mails, 20 files) seeded into the test tenant by `python -m seeder seed` (L1.2). It is the expected set the Worker verifies restores against (W3.1 reads it, W3.2 compares). Written as UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, 2-space indent and LF line endings. Hashes are 64 lower-case hex SHA-256 digits; dates are ISO-8601 UTC with whole seconds (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ). Some rules the schema cannot express are checked by lab/seeder/manifest.py validate_manifest: entry ids are unique and in catalog order, mail subject == id, file name == id, file_type == the name's extension, location.mailbox == recipient, stored_matches_local == (stored_sha256 == local_sha256), body_readback_exact implies body_sha256 == sent_body_sha256, and dates are real calendar dates.

schema.title: Schema id
schema.description: Always "seed-manifest.v1". A reader must refuse any other value.

tenant.title: Tenant domain
tenant.description: Initial domain of the Microsoft 365 test tenant the items were seeded into, e.g. RestoreProofLab.onmicrosoft.com.

tenant_id.title: Tenant id
tenant_id.description: Entra ID (Azure AD) tenant GUID of the test tenant, lower-case.

seeded_at.title: Seeded at
seeded_at.description: UTC time the seed run wrote this manifest. Veeam backups taken after this time contain all 40 items.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Plain-English statements of how the set is laid out and how to compare restored items. Informational; the entry fields are authoritative.

mail_recipients.title: Mail recipients rule
mail_recipients.description: Which mailbox holds which canary mail and who sent them.

file_types.title: File types rule
file_types.description: How the file type follows from the file number.

file_locations.title: File locations rule
file_locations.description: Which files are in the SharePoint library and which in the OneDrive folder.

file_hash.title: File hash rule
file_hash.description: Which hash a restored file is compared with (stored_sha256).

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: Exactly 40 items: mails RP-CANARY-0001..RP-CANARY-0020 in order, then files rp-canary-01..rp-canary-20 in order. The kind field selects the entry shape.

sha256.title: SHA-256
sha256.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lower-case hex characters.

utc_datetime.title: UTC date-time
utc_datetime.description: ISO-8601 UTC date-time with whole seconds and a Z suffix, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Graph's fractional seconds are dropped (truncated) and offsets converted to UTC.

upn.title: User principal name
upn.description: A user's sign-in name / primary SMTP address in the test tenant.

non_empty.title: Non-empty string
non_empty.description: An opaque identifier; compare it exactly.

size.title: Size in bytes
size.description: Byte count of a file's content.

file_type.title: File type
file_type.description: The file's extension. Cycles pdf, docx, xlsx, txt, png by file number (01 pdf ... 20 png).

mail_entry.title: Mail entry
mail_entry.description: A plain-text mail sent by the tenant admin to alice (0001..0010) or bob (0011..0020), as read back from the recipient's mailbox through Microsoft Graph.

id.title: Entry id
id.description: Unique entry id; for mails the same as the subject, RP-CANARY-0001..RP-CANARY-0020.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Message subject; equal to id. Use it to find the restored message.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: from.emailAddress.address as Graph returned it on read-back (the admin). Compare case-insensitively.

recipient.title: Recipient
recipient.description: UPN of the mailbox the mail was sent to (from the catalog).

location.title: Mail location
location.description: Where the message sits in the tenant.

mailbox.title: Mailbox
mailbox.description: UPN of the mailbox holding the message; equal to recipient.

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: displayName of the message's parent folder at seed time (normally Inbox).

received_at.title: Received at
received_at.description: Graph receivedDateTime in the recipient's mailbox, UTC, whole seconds.

internet_message_id.title: Internet message id
internet_message_id.description: RFC 5322 Message-ID (Graph internetMessageId), angle brackets included. Stable across restores.

graph_message_id.title: Graph message id
graph_message_id.description: Graph ImmutableId of the message in the recipient's mailbox (read with Prefer: IdType="ImmutableId"). A restored copy gets a new id.

body_content_type.title: Body content type
body_content_type.description: Always "text": the body was sent as text and read back with Prefer: outlook.body-content-type="text".

body_normalization.title: Body normalisation
body_normalization.description: Always "text-v1": drop one leading U+FEFF; CRLF then lone CR to LF; strip trailing spaces and tabs per line; strip trailing LFs; UTF-8. Vectors: shared/testdata/body-normalization-text-v1.json.

body_sha256.title: Body SHA-256
body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the body READ BACK from the recipient's mailbox, normalised with body_normalization. Compare a restored message's normalised body with this.

sent_body_sha256.title: Sent body SHA-256
sent_body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the catalog body that was sent, normalised the same way. Lets `python -m seeder hash` re-check the catalog offline.

body_readback_exact.title: Body read back exactly
body_readback_exact.description: True when the read-back body string equalled the sent string before normalisation. When true, body_sha256 == sent_body_sha256.

file_entry_common.title: File entry fields
file_entry_common.description: Fields shared by SharePoint and OneDrive file entries (location is defined per kind).

id.title: Entry id
id.description: Unique entry id; for files the same as the file name.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: sharepoint_file or onedrive_file; selects the location shape.

name.title: File name
name.description: The driveItem name; equal to id.

location.title: File location
location.description: Where the file sits; shape depends on kind.

drive_item_id.title: Drive item id
drive_item_id.description: Graph driveItem id of the uploaded file. A restored copy gets a new id.

uploaded_by.title: Uploaded by
uploaded_by.description: UPN that uploaded the file (from the catalog): the admin for SharePoint, alice for OneDrive.

last_modified_at.title: Last modified at
last_modified_at.description: driveItem lastModifiedDateTime after the upload, UTC, whole seconds.

local_sha256.title: Local SHA-256
local_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the committed file lab/canary/<name>. `python -m seeder hash` re-checks it offline.

stored_sha256.title: Stored SHA-256
stored_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes Graph returned when the file was downloaded back after upload (SharePoint may rewrite Office files). Compare a restored file with this, not local_sha256.

stored_size.title: Stored size
stored_size.description: Byte size of the bytes downloaded back through Graph.

sharepoint_file_entry.title: SharePoint file entry
sharepoint_file_entry.description: rp-canary-01..10, in the root folder of the SharePoint RestoreTest document library.

location.title: SharePoint location
location.description: Site, library and folder holding the file.

site_id.title: Site id
site_id.description: Graph site id (hostname,siteCollectionId,webId) of the RestoreTest site.

list_id.title: List id
list_id.description: SharePoint list GUID of the RestoreTest document library.

drive_id.title: Drive id
drive_id.description: Graph drive id of the RestoreTest document library.

folder_id.title: Folder id
folder_id.description: Real driveItem id of the parent folder (parentReference.id), not the alias "root".

folder_path.title: Folder path
folder_path.description: Path of the parent folder inside the library; "/" is the library root.

onedrive_file_entry.title: OneDrive file entry
onedrive_file_entry.description: rp-canary-11..20, in the RestoreTest folder of alice's OneDrive.

location.title: OneDrive location
location.description: User, drive and folder holding the file.

user.title: OneDrive owner
user.description: UPN of the user whose OneDrive holds the file (alice).

drive_id.title: Drive id
drive_id.description: Graph drive id of the user's OneDrive.

folder_id.title: Folder id
folder_id.description: driveItem id of the RestoreTest folder (parentReference.id).

folder_path.title: Folder path
folder_path.description: Path of the parent folder from the drive root, e.g. /RestoreTest.
